# Chennai Surgical & Pharma Generics

> Medical, surgical and hospital equipment supplier in Chennai, India, established 1998. Supplies home patient care, hospital & clinic equipment, diagnostic lab supplies, school/college lab equipment, and ready-made kits. 3,000+ products. Delivers pan-India.

## Product categories
- Home & Patient Care: wheelchairs, walkers, adult diapers, BP monitors, nebulizers, oxygen concentrators, hospital cots for home use, orthopaedic supports, wound care
- Hospital & Clinic: hospital furniture and cots, surgical instruments, syringes and blood collection tubes, IV fluids, sterilization equipment, stethoscopes, physiotherapy equipment, biomedical waste management, hospital linen
- Diagnostic Labs: lab glassware and plasticware, blood collection supplies, lab consumables, lab protective wear
- Schools & Colleges: chemistry/physics/biology lab equipment, nursing student kits (CNS kit, goniometer kit, nursing article kit), manikins, student scrub suits
- Ready-Made Kits: ICU-at-home setup, peritoneal dialysis (PD) patient care kit, home wound-dressing kit, new clinic setup package
